description.fun: Six Pokémon that count as one: five troopers and the brass at the front, whose orders are absolute. They march in single file and keep changing formation as they fight, like soldiers in a phalanx, which with 'links' gives Falinks its name. It's the only Pokémon from Sword and Shield that can Mega Evolve, a power it gained in Legends: Z-A.
description.guide: A Fighting-type Pokémon made of six individuals: five troopers and a leader called the brass. Falinks gained a Mega Evolution in Pokémon Legends: Z-A, the only Generation VIII Pokémon to have one.
description.tagline: Six soldiers marching as one Pokémon

description.fun: The six stack into a single warrior, their 'ultimate battle formation', which only the strongest bonds make possible. The brass becomes the head, one trooper a spear arm and another a shield, all held up by a middle trooper with a pained look. It ends up 1.4 metres shorter, the biggest height drop of any Mega Evolution.
